outcome: onset and duration of sensory and motor blockade
cohort: 96 patients with ASA status 2, aged 18 to 40, undergoing elective cesarean section surgery under subarachnoid block
finding: 2-chloroprocaine with fentanyl prolonged the duration of sensory block and post-operative analgesia compared to 2-chloroprocaine alone in patients undergoing elective caesarean section.
